summary: The camera executes a continuous forward push, passing directly through the glowing crystal to emerge in a darker continuation of the tunnel, which then opens seamlessly into the destination corridor.
observations: The camera moves forward, pushing into the crystal cluster until the facets completely fill the frame (t=2.00s).
Upon passing through the crystal, the environment remains a root tunnel but is much darker, revealing the destination space ahead (t=3.00s).
The camera continuously travels out of the dark tunnel's mouth and fully enters the reflective corridor, matching the intended destination perfectly (t=5.00s to t=5.99s).
